items.title: Trezor Reduces Number of Resellers Following Ledger Drainage Incident
items.summary:
Bitcoin Magazine  
  
 Trezor Reduces Number of Resellers Following Ledger Drainage Incident   
 Hardware manufacturer Trezor has said it is checking which vendors it works with following reports of lost funds from Ledger models.  
 This post  Trezor Reduces Number of Resellers Following Ledger Drainage Incident   first appeared on  Bitcoin Magazine  and is written by  Mathew Di Salvo .

items.title: Ripple, Stripe-owned Privy partner to bring embedded wallets to XRP Ledger
items.summary: Developers can now build XRPL wallets into apps via Privy, with support for XRP, RLUSD, AI agent payments and x402.

items.title: Strive reports $208M in warrant exercises as Bitcoin holdings jump 11%
items.summary: Strive is now the fifth-largest publicly traded corporate Bitcoin holder, with 32,773 BTC, as it continues to expand its treasury through equity financing.

items.title: Crypto exchange MNX takes on OKX, BitGet offering pre-IPO futures for AI giants
items.summary: MNX is offering a different way to trade the future valuations of private AI companies, including OpenAI, Anthropic and DeepSeek.

items.title: Strive Buys More Bitcoin, Crosses 30,000 BTC Mark
items.summary:
Bitcoin Magazine  
  
 Strive Buys More Bitcoin, Crosses 30,000 BTC Mark   
 The bitcoin treasury company is still the fifth biggest in the space.  
 This post  Strive Buys More Bitcoin, Crosses 30,000 BTC Mark   first appeared on  Bitcoin Magazine  and is written by  Mathew Di Salvo .

items.title: Bitcoin keeps up pressure on $84K as US stocks skirt Korea tech sell-off
items.summary: Bitcoin price action preserved overnight gains as US stocks quickly rebounded after opening lower on the back of Korea’s tech-stock rout.

items.title: UK crypto trader says almost $800,000 lost in knife attack as wrench attacks proliferate
items.summary: A crypto trader in the U.K. claimed masked intruders stole nearly $800,000 in cryptocurrency at knifepoint, furthering concerns of "wrench attacks" spreading in the country.

items.title: Interactive Brokers expands crypto services with Ethereum staking via Zerohash
items.summary: Interactive Brokers now lets eligible clients stake ETH through its Client Portal, with zerohash providing the service.

items.title: DRW and Marex complete OTC swap referencing tokenized S&P iBoxx Index
items.summary: DRW and Marex completed the first OTC swap referencing a fully tokenized index on Derivnex via the Canton Network, with Kaiko data.

items.title: AI Powered PlayStation Crack Could Let You Play GTA 6 on PC at Launch
items.summary: AnyPS5 is working to get any PS5 game running natively on PC—and gamers are hoping it'll work for the next instalment of Grand Theft Auto.

items.title: Ledger confirms hardware implant in CryptoBilis reseller units as MediaMarkt suspends sales in Europe
items.summary: Ledger confirmed a hardware implant in CryptoBilis-sold devices steals recovery phrases, as MediaMarkt suspends sales.

items.title: Anthropic warns ‘AI worms’ may autonomously spread across devices like a virus
items.summary: Anthropic warned that rogue “AI worms” are months away from the ability to self-replicate and autonomously infect user devices such as home appliances and other internet-connected devices.

items.title: Strive buys 3,311 bitcoin for $280 million in largest acquisition since January
items.summary: Strive added 3,311 BTC between Oct. 5 and Oct. 9, bringing holdings to 32,773 BTC and narrowing the gap with MARA.

items.title: Is Bitcoin kidding itself about the Lightning Network?
items.summary: Bitcoin developer Paul Sztorc says Bitcoiners are lying to themselves about Lightning. Developers claim usability has improved, but questions remain over everyday adoption.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Alex Gladstein: How The Bitcoin-AI Convergence Impacts the Fight for Freedom
items.summary:
Bitcoin Magazine  
  
 Alex Gladstein: How The Bitcoin-AI Convergence Impacts the Fight for Freedom  
 AI risk isn't human extinction, says HRF’s Alex Gladstein—it’s centralized control. He explains why local, open-source AI is vital for protecting freedom. 
 This post  Alex Gladstein: How The Bitcoin-AI Convergence Impacts the Fight for Freedom  first appeared on  Bitcoin Magazine  and is written by  Patrick Green .

items.title: Digital cash offers ‘cash-like privacy,’ but bank data breaches threaten users: BIS
items.summary: BIS said that digital cash can achieve “cash-like privacy,” however, the technology isn’t yet production-ready due to risks such as bank data breaches.

items.title: Matt Dines: Why a Rising Dollar is Bullish for Bitcoin
items.summary:
Bitcoin Magazine  
  
 Matt Dines: Why a Rising Dollar is Bullish for Bitcoin  
 The dollar and Bitcoin are both rising—a bullish sign, says Build Asset Management's Matt Dines. He breaks down the shift to a new US-led monetary order. 
 This post  Matt Dines: Why a Rising Dollar is Bullish for Bitcoin  first appeared on  Bitcoin Magazine  and is written by  Patrick Green .

items.title: Russia clears Sberbank for crypto trading ahead of December launch
items.summary: Russia’s largest bank, Sberbank, has secured crypto exchange authorization as it prepares to offer Bitcoin, Ether and Tether USDt trading.

items.title: South Korea blocks 27 crypto exchanges, including Bitmart and Kucoin
items.summary: The country’s regulators are stepping up their earlier restrictions on mobile apps to websites, targeting unregistered exchanges before investors report losses.

items.title: Federated Hermes joins Wall Street's tokenization push with plans for first onchain fund shares
items.summary: The $911 billion Pittsburgh-based asset manager is teaming up with Prometheum to bring blockchain-based share classes of its funds to traditional brokerage accounts.

items.title: Ledger Finds LTE Implant That Stole Recovery Phrases in Suspected $86M Drain
items.summary: Ledger says the hidden chip reads the 24-word phrase off the screen during setup, leaving the Secure Element and its software untouched.

items.title: Binance to shut down mining pool, cloud mining and related services
items.summary: Binance said it will shut down its mining pool, cloud mining, and Pool Savings services on Nov. 10.

items.title: Morning Minute: Bitcoin Gets Spooked as ‘Uptober’ Lets Down
items.summary: Crypto majors are red, alts are down bad and onchain is facing capitulation. This was not the ‘Uptober’ that was promised…

items.title: UK High Court rules Chinese law governs claims over $5 billion in seized bitcoin
items.summary: A UK judge ruled Chinese law applies to victims' claims over 61,000 seized bitcoin, leaving ownership undecided.
